# Feel Your Protocol — Website Documentation

> Human-oriented docs for the Feel Your Protocol **explorations website** —
> interactive, hands-on widgets for Ethereum protocol changes (EIPs, ERCs, research).
> Humans instruct and review; agents implement via skills and source.
> Does **not** cover roadmap, community token, or MCP server development (see each
> folder's README in the GitHub repo).

Each exploration is a self-contained folder under `src/explorations/` with metadata
(`info.ts`) and an interactive widget (`MyC.vue`). Real Ethereum library code runs
in the browser.

Repo agent entrypoint: https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website/blob/main/AGENTS.md
Round-trip skill (EIP → exploration → MCP → optional comic): https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website/blob/main/.cursor/skills/round-trip-protocol-change/SKILL.md
Add-exploration skill: https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website/blob/main/.cursor/skills/add-exploration/SKILL.md
Cover-image skill: https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website/blob/main/.cursor/skills/cover-image/SKILL.md
Bro & Bruh comic skill: https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website/blob/main/.cursor/skills/bro-bruh-comic/SKILL.md

## Guide

- [Getting Started](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/guide/getting-started.html): Prerequisites, local setup, quality checks
- [Architecture](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/guide/architecture.html): Folder-per-exploration model, taxonomies (Topics, Timeline, Tags), E-Components
- [Changelog](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/changelog.html): Structural-base history

## Building

- [Overview](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/building/overview.html): Brief an agent, review the result — file map and quality gates
- [Adding an Exploration](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/adding-an-exploration.html): Folder contract, metadata judgment table, human review checklist
- [Images](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/images.html): Cover art rules (human brief); prompts in cover-image skill
- [UI Components](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/ui-components.html): Placement rules — shared vs exploration-local
- [E-Components](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/e-components.html): Integration intent, slots, composition direction
- [Available E-Components](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/available-e-components.html): Which pattern to copy — reference folders, not API dumps
- [Styling & Design](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/styling.html): Topic colors and design-system rules (no CSS class catalog)
- [Code Conventions](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/code-conventions.html): Naming (`MyC`, `EC`, `UIC`)
- [Third-Party Libraries](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/third-party-libraries.html): How new library dependencies are evaluated and added
- [Video Pipeline](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/video-pipeline.html): Short-form exploration videos — architecture, overlays, recording
- [Authoring a Video Short](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/video-authoring.html): How to plan, write, and record exploration shorts

## Related (live sites, not dev docs here)

- [Main site](https://feelyourprotocol.org/): Live interactive explorations
- [All FYP docs (fleet hub)](https://docs.feelyourprotocol.org/): Entry card to website docs, MCP docs, roadmap, community token
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website): Monorepo — sibling-site READMEs for non-website dev work

## Notes

- Built with VitePress; Markdown sources live in `website-docs/` on GitHub.
- Beta: reusable component APIs may evolve. Latest docs always apply — no version switching.
- Educational, open-source software provided as-is; not affiliated with the Ethereum Foundation.
